content: Wehi kan me Luhwehdi nan Sahpwo
KAUN-O eri ketikihong nan sahpwo ekei tohn wehi pwe re en kin kasongosonge mehn Israel ko me sohte iang sairada apwal en mahwen kan nan Kenan.
E ketin wiahda met pwe en ketin padahkihong ehuehu dih en Israel duwen mahwen, ahpw mehlel irail ko me sohte iang sair apwal en mahwen mahs.
Me luhwehdi nan sahpwo iei kahnimw limau en mehn Pilisdia kan, mehn Kenan koaros, mehn Saidon, oh mehn Ip me kousoan ni nahna kan en Lepanon sang Nahna Paal Ermon lellahng ni Wasahn Kot en Amad.
Irail wia mehn kasongosong ong mehn Israel kan, pwe KAUN-O en kadiarakda ma mehn Israel kan pahn kin peikiong kosonned akan me e ketikihong Moses pwe en patohwanohng ar pahpa kahlap ako.
Eri, mehn Israel ko ahpw soandiong nanpwungen mehn Kenan, mehn Id, mehn Amor, mehn Peris, mehn Ip, oh mehn Sepus.
Re pwopwoudpene nanpwungarail oh iang kaudokiong ar koht kan.
Odniel
Mehn Israel ko ahpw manokehla KAUN-O, arail Koht; re dipadahr oh kin kaudokiong sansal akan en Paal oh Asera.
KAUN-O eri ketin engiengkihda met pahn Israel oh mweidohng Kusan Risadaim, nanmwarkien Mesopodamia en kaloweiraildi. Irail eri mihmihte pahn sapwellime manaman erein sounpar waluh.
Mehn Israel ko eri sohpeiong KAUN-O oh e ketin poaronedohng irail emen ohl me pahn kapitirailla. Ih ohl menet Odniel, nein Kenas rien Kalep pwutak me tikitik.
Ngenen KAUN-O ahpw ti powe, ih eri wiahla kaunen mehn Israel ko. Odniel eri tapihada mahwen; KAUN-O eri ketikihong pwe en powehdi nanmwarkien Mesopodamia.
Meleilei ahpw miehla nan sahpw erein sounpar pahisek, mwuhr Odniel ahpw mehla.
Ehud
Mehn Israel ko pil pwurehng dipada ong KAUN-O. Pwehki kahrepe wet, KAUN-O ketin kakehlailihala Eklon, nanmwarkien Mohap, ih eri pelianda mehn Israel ko.
Eklon eri ehuong mehn Ammon ko oh mehn Amalek ko, re ahpw kalowehdi mehn Israel ko oh koledi Seriko, kahnimw en nih tohto.
Mehn Israel ko eri mihla pahn manaman en Eklon erein sounpar eisek waluh.

Mehn Israel ko ahpw pwurehng sohpeiong KAUN-O oh e ketin poaronedohng irail emen ohl me pahn kapitirailla. Eri met iei Ehud, ohl meingtoal emen, nein Kera, kisehn kadaudok en Pensamin. Mehn Israel ko eri kadarala Ehud rehn Eklon, nanmwarkien Mohap, iangahkihla ar kisakis kan.
Ehud wiahda nah kedlahs pwoat me keng pali riau oh reireiki piht ehu elep. E ahpw katengediong nin lukepe nan eh likou kan.
E ahpw wa kohla kisakis ko ong Eklon, ohl mworourou men.
Ahnsou me Ehud patohwanohng kisakis ko, e patohwanohng ienge aramas ako re en patopatohla ni imwarail.

A pein Ehud wetite limwahn sansal takai ko me mi Kilkal, pwurala rehn Eklon oh patohwanohng, “Wasa Lapalap, mie mehkot rir me I men sekerehkin komwi.” Nanmwarkio eri mahsanihong sapwellime ladu ko re en kohieisang wasa ira mihmi ieo. Irail eri kohkohieisang nan pereo.
Mwuri, ni ahnsou me nanmwarki kelehpw ketiket nan pere lemwulemwur ehu pohn ihmwo, Ehud patohla reh oh patohwan, “Mie koasoandi ehu rehi me sang rehn Koht ong komwi.” Nanmwarkio ahpw ketida.
Ehud alehki nah kedlahso pali peh meingtoal oh doakoahki kapehden nanmwarkio.
Kedlahso pwon iangahki mangileo pwarolong nan kapehdeo, wihn kapehdeo ahpw kidimpene, Ehud sohte usasang ni kapehdeo, imwio pweripweriei nanpwungen denge ko.
Ehud ahpw kohieila liki, ritingedi wenihmwo oh lokehdi, ih eri kohkohlahsang.
Ladu ko eri patohdo oh kilangada me wenihmwo loak, re ahpw kikihong me nanmwarkio ketin lokolokewel
loale.
Re ahpw awiawih ekis werei, oh ni eh sohte ritingada wenihmwo, re ale kih oh ritingada. Oh iet arail mwohnsapwo, wonohn nan taht pwoulahr.
Ehud ahpw tangasang mwo nindokon ar awiawih nanmwarkio. E keidla mwohn sansal takai ko oh tangalahng Seira.
Ni eh lel mwo nan sahpw nahnahn Epraim, e peuk sowi ehu pwe mehn Israel ko en pokonpenehn mahwen, e ahpw kahluwairaildi sang pohn dohl ako.

E ndaiong irail, “Kumwail idawehniehdo. KAUN-O kupwuredahr kumwail en powehdi mehn Mohap kan, amwail imwintihti.” Irail eri idawehndihla Ehud oh kalowehdi wasa me mehn Mohap ko mihmi ie pwe re en kotehla Sordan; re ahpw sohte mweidohng mehmen rehrail en kotehla pillapo.
Rahno re kemehla sounpei kehlail en Mohap nen, sohte emen pitla.
Rahno mehn Israel ko eri kalowehdi mehn Mohap ko, oh sang ahnsowo kohla meleilei ahpw miehla nan sahpwo erein pahr welihsek.
Samkar
Kaun me kohdo mwuri iei Samkar nein Anad. E pil kapitala mehn Israel ko ni eh kemehkihla mehn Pilisdia wenlop mehn deipwel en kou.
